Title: Cognitive Services Custom Vision is now available

Body.Content:
Cognitive Services Custom Vision is now available. Use it to easily customize your own state-of-the-art computer vision models for your unique use case. Just upload a few labeled images and let Custom Vision Service do the hard work. With just one click, you can export trained models to be run on device or as Docker containers.

Upload Images

Upload your own labeled images, or use Custom Vision Service to quickly tag any unlabeled images.

Train

Use your labeled images to teach Custom Vision Service the concepts you want it to learn.

Evaluate

Use simple REST API calls to quickly tag images with your new custom computer vision model, or simply export the model to device to run real-time image understanding.

Active learning

Images evaluated through your custom vision model become part of a feedback loop you can use to keep improving your classifier.

Learn more
